articles.title: GHSA: dnspython dns.name.from_wire_parser() excessive CPU use
articles.summary:
### Impact
A maliciously crafted DNS message may cause dns.name.from_wire_parser() to use excessive CPU for DNS name decompression.  Applications that process untrusted DNS wire form messages with dnspython may be degraded or DoS'd by the extra CPU use required.

### Patches
This problem is fixed in dnspython 2.9.0.

### Workarounds
There are no known workarounds.

articles.title: GHSA: NLTK: WekaClassifier passes an unvalidated caller-controlled model path to the weka JVM, bypassing nltk.pathsec containment
articles.summary:
## Summary
`WekaClassifier` in NLTK passes a caller-controlled model file path to the weka Java VM without any `nltk.pathsec` validation. `WekaClassifier.train` puts the caller's `model_filename` verbatim into the weka argv `["-d", model_filename, ...]` (weka *writes* the trained model there), and `WekaClassifier._classify_many` puts `self._model` into `["-l", self._model, ...]` (weka *reads* it).
